subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: After the Settings control is restored to the common leading-edge position, should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar shell and its persisted sidebar preferences as the iPhone root-navigation model?
rationale: This is a protected, maintainer-directed replacement of the primary iPhone navigation model rather than a narrow bug fix; code review can verify consistency but cannot choose the long-term product direction.

options.title: Approve after consistency repair
options.body: Keep the sidebar-shell direction, move the Settings reveal action to the leading edge, and land after the owner confirms the navigation and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow or pause the redesign
options.body: Retain the current navigation model or split the redesign if maintainers do not want the new sidebar preferences and destination model to become the iPhone default.

recommendation.title: Approve after consistency repair
recommendation.body: Keep the sidebar-shell direction, move the Settings reveal action to the leading edge, and land after the owner confirms the navigation and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR and related product-direction context identify this person as the closest available routing candidate for the redesign decision.
